description:
Get a US public company's financials as filed with the SEC: revenue, operating income, net income, diluted EPS, total assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow and shares outstanding — last 4 fiscal years plus the latest quarter, each tied to its filing.

$0.004 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

When to use: You need a US public company's reported numbers.
Use instead: company_snapshot to get the profile and filings in the same call; company_due_diligence for computed ratios.
Parameters: ticker or cik (one is required).
Returns: revenue, operating and net income, diluted EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow and shares, for the last 4 fiscal years and the latest quarter, each tied to its filing.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key. Give this or ticker.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. "NVDA". Give this or cik.

name: sec_financials
title: Company financials from SEC filings
